svg.title: Hold the Station
svg.desc: Hold the Station measured battlefield. North is up. Arrows measure terrain edges and objective centers from table edges. Terrain labels give width by depth in inches. Attacker: hold both access sites at two consecutive round ends.

g.text: Arrows: distance to edge or point. All measurements in inches.
Attacker: hold both access sites at two consecutive round ends.
Terrain borders are exact. Patterns do not add obstacles.
